services.desc: Whether you're new to camping or want it to be set up for you, Adventure Hill is the place to be! We will provide 4 and 6 person tents, water, firewood, and access to bathrooms. The $30 registration cost includes one 4 or 6 person tent. There will be options to add additional tents if needed. The cost per person includes the cost for smores and a light continental breakfast on Sunday All Ages

services.name: Aerial Yoga
services.desc: Take your yoga practice to the air literally with OUTDOOR Aerial Yoga! This specialty and unique style of yoga uses a hammock to strengthen, support and suspend your body. Open up energy lines and loosen fascia and connective tissue, while having FUN! The hammock is used as a tool to rock and soothe sore and tight muscles and minds. Expect to release tension on your bones and muscles, increasing flexibility and strength. This is an introduction to Aerial Yoga and suitable for all levels. Learn how to use the hammock as a prop, explore various basic inversions, and a sample of restorative For ages 8+

services.name: Pool SUP Yoga
services.desc: Experience mindfulness mixed with challenge and adventure as you take your practice from land to water! Held by anchors in a pool, you'll be led through a series of yoga postures designed for a paddleboard. From basic to advanced, have FUN exploring your edges and maybe falling into the water trying! Beginners at yoga and SUP are welcome! services.desc: Our Adaptive 1-on-1 Program at Bretton Woods Recreation Center is dedicated to providing personalized outdoor experiences for children and teens of all abilities and needs. This program pairs each participant with a trained adventure guide who offers individualized attention and support throughout a variety of outdoor activities, ensuring safety, accessibility, and fun. Participants can explore a wide range of adaptive adventures, including kayaking, hiking, ropes courses, and wilderness exploration, all tailored to their unique abilities and comfort levels. School Program
services.desc: Bretton Woods offers enriching School Programs designed to complement classroom learning with hands-on outdoor education. Our programs provide students with immersive experiences in nature that foster environmental awareness, teamwork, and personal growth. Tailored to fit a variety of grade levels and curriculum goals, activities include ecology studies, wildlife observation, conservation projects, team challenges, and outdoor skills development. These engaging lessons encourage critical thinking, creativity, and a deeper connection to the natural world. Led by experienced educators and Kindergarden and Up • Email to Book

services.name: Team Building
services.desc: Strengthen connections, boost communication, and foster collaboration with Teambuilding at Bretton Woods. Our dynamic outdoor teambuilding programs are designed to bring groups together through fun, challenging activities that encourage trust, problem-solving, and teamwork. Participants engage in a variety of interactive exercises such as ropes courses, cooperative games, group challenges, and wilderness problem-solving—all aimed at enhancing leadership skills and group cohesion in an inspiring natural setting.
